verdict.rationale: Cline has the building blocks for an issue-to-PR workflow: you can chat with the agent from Linear, run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions or GitLab pipelines, and execute autonomously with auto-approve. Kanban adds per-card git worktrees with auto-commit and diff review. However, no evidence documents an actual issue-to-pull-request flow, so assembling one from these pieces is left to the user. Missing for 10: documented issue-to-PR workflow, automatic PR creation/opening, issue-tracker ingestion beyond chat, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end PR delivery.
